verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Memory MCP Server that lets MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) connect to a user's agent memory, confirmed by both docs and a live probe; it also offers a separate Graphiti MCP server for its knowledge-graph library. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working in practice and more detail on setup/auth beyond docs.
